parsed.post: My last attempt (0.865) regressed compared to my best (0.834). The jump in learning rate likely caused instability or overshooting. I'm reverting to the 0.834 baseline and will instead focus on a more surgical adjustment: slightly increasing the batch size to improve gradient stability at the current learning rate.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit (692c13d) and doubling TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 1048576 to improve gradient estimates and stability, while keeping the previous successful MATRIX_LR.
